subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up: expected monthly tokens & peak TPS
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up: expected monthly tokens & peak TPS

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and two asks so we can put together a hosted API pricing recommendation that fits your budget and traffic patterns.

Recap (from our call):
- Primary use case: in-app customer support automation (ticket triage + short contextual replies).
- Typical request size: ~60 tokens prompt, ~40 tokens generation (avg 100 tokens per transaction).
- Authentication + compliance: standard SOC2 acceptable, no special on-prem requirement for now.

Open items we discussed — please confirm the numbers below or correct them:
1) Expected monthly token volume (aggregate): you mentioned a mid-range scenario of ~50M tokens/month and a growth case up to 200M/month. Which is the target for the next 90 days?
2) Budget: you indicated a target spend band of $2k–$10k/month initially. Is that committed budget or exploratory?
3) Peak TPS (requests/sec): you called out a peak window around customer-support spikes — roughly 8–12 TPS for brief periods. Can you confirm peak TPS and whether you need sub-100ms tail latency?

If you can reply with explicit numbers for (1) and (3) we’ll produce a price sketch (unit $/1M tokens) and a suggested plan (burst + baseline throughput) that meets your SLOs.

Next steps from my side: I’ll loop in pricing and put together a short quote and a couple of deployment patterns in the console (burst vs. reserved capacity) assuming hosted API. Marissa — tagging you for any CS/implementation notes.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Zhang <olivia@fintechco.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up: expected monthly tokens & peak TPS

Alex — thanks for the recap and for the clear asks. Numbers below are the best estimates from our product + infra teams after the call.

1) Expected monthly tokens (next 90 days):
- Baseline (realistic): 50M tokens/month (this is our conservative forecast as we roll out to a subset of customers).
- Upside/growth scenario: 180–220M tokens/month if adoption goes well after product launch.

2) Budget:
- Initial committed budget: $3,500/month.
- We have headroom to $8k/mo if unit economics and latency look good in the pilot.

3) Peak TPS / latency requirements:
- Peak observed during support surge tests: ~11 TPS sustained for ~2–3 minute bursts.
- Average TPS outside peaks: ~1–2 TPS.
- Latency tolerance: 200–300ms median acceptable, but we’d prefer <500ms p95 for a good user experience.

Extra notes on token mix: most calls are short replies — ~30% of requests are 200+ token sessions (larger context), but 70% are under 120 tokens total. We can provide a small sample prompt distribution if useful.

Happy to proceed — please send the hosted API price estimate (target $/1M tokens) and any recommended burst configuration.

Cheers,
Olivia Zhang
Head of Product

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up: expected monthly tokens & peak TPS

Hi Olivia — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Based on those numbers I sketched three hosted API options and attached a short quote (see attachment). High-level callout here so you have the quick math: 

Assumptions
- Avg tokens per transaction: 100 tokens (you called out mix; I’m using 100 as a weighted average).
- Baseline volume: 50M tokens/month (500k transactions).
- Peak TPS: 11 TPS (burst windows ~2–3 minutes).

Pricing sketch (hosted API) — target unit economics to discuss:
- Pilot / self-serve tier: $35 / 1M tokens -> implies ~$1,750/month on 50M tokens (overages billed monthly).
- Production / recommended tier (with SLA & burst capacity): $20 / 1M tokens -> implies ~$1,000/month on 50M tokens (this includes a small reserved baseline + auto-burst allowance; higher durability and observability).
- Enterprise discounted tier (committed 12mo): $12 / 1M tokens -> $600/month on 50M tokens (requires commit and 3–5 day provisioning for reserved capacity).

Notes:
- The numbers above are illustrative — they’re intentionally tiered to map to your stated budget ($3.5k/mo committed target aligns with the Production tier if you scale toward ~150M tokens).
- For the 11 TPS bursts, hosted API’s auto-burst handles short peaks; if you need sustained high TPS we’d recommend a Reserved baseline (Dedicated) for predictable tail latency.
- We can optimize unit cost with batching and prefix caching for the 70% smaller requests; Marissa can run a quick eval on a small traffic sample to estimate token savings.

Next steps:
1) I attached a one-page quote (redwood_quote_fintechco_v1.pdf) with the three tiers and a recommended pilot plan.
2) If the Production tier looks good, we can start a 30-day pilot at $20/1M tokens (no long-term commit) with a $3.5k pre-pay to cover the first month.
3) Marissa — can you run an eval on the sample prompt distribution to estimate % token savings from caching/batching?

Olivia — if that pricing band looks reasonable, I’ll get a formal DocuSign over and we’ll schedule a short kickoff with implementation (API keys + sample integration) next week.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
